badge.name: Crypto Data Specialist
badge.description: Demonstrates an understanding of cryptocurrency price aggregation, volume-weighted pricing, and mock portfolio valuation.

title: Understanding Cryptocurrency Price Feeds and Portfolio Valuation
notFor: Individuals seeking real-time high-frequency trading execution strategies or automated arbitrage bots.

lessons.title: Exchange Tickers and Price Aggregation Foundations
lessons.summary: Learn how individual cryptocurrency exchanges generate ticker prices and how data aggregators synthesize this information into a unified market rate.

lessons.title: API Delays and Portfolio Valuation Mechanics
lessons.summary: Examine how data transmission delays, API snapshots, and cache intervals impact the valuation and execution of virtual portfolios.

lessons.title: Portfolio Rebalancing and Cash Drag Dynamics
lessons.summary: Learn how to rebalance a virtual portfolio with cash components and manage the impact of transaction delays on asset allocation.

tagline: Learn how digital asset prices are calculated, aggregated, and applied to virtual portfolios.
outcomes: Calculate volume-weighted average prices using exchange ticker data
Explain why outlier filtering requires the provider’s methodology and observation timestamps
Analyze the impact of API delays on virtual portfolio execution
Value a paper-trading portfolio using real-time and snapshot price feeds
description: Explore the mechanics behind cryptocurrency price feeds, from raw exchange tickers and volume-weighted averages to data aggregation methodologies, API delays, and paper-portfolio valuation techniques.
progression: Start with venue tickers and a volume-weighted arithmetic example, then compare observation times and delayed portfolio marks. Finish with cash-inclusive allocation and a fee-aware rebalance. These lessons do not establish readiness for statistical trading or algorithmic execution.
prerequisites: Basic understanding of spot trading concepts and simple mathematical averages.

badge.name: Bitcoin Practice Course Completion
badge.description: Awarded for completing virtual Bitcoin trading lessons and quizzes; not a certification of trading competence.

title: Bitcoin Paper Trading: Price Snapshots, Virtual Orders and Portfolio Review
notFor: Users seeking real money investment recommendations, exchange execution, futures, leverage, short selling, guaranteed returns or proof of trading competence.

lessons.title: Setting Up Your Bitcoin Simulator Environment
lessons.summary: Learn how virtual cash, provider price snapshots and simulated order limitations work in TradeHQ.

lessons.title: Executing Spot Trades in the Simulator
lessons.summary: Learn step-by-step mechanics for placing market buy and sell orders within a virtual spot portfolio.

lessons.title: Evaluating Performance and Managing Drawdowns
lessons.summary: Analyze virtual trading results, calculate portfolio drawdowns, and evaluate the assumptions behind a hypothetical approach based on objective data.

tagline: Understand Bitcoin spot simulation, 0.1% virtual transaction fees, quote freshness and drawdown exercises.
outcomes: Calculate a virtual Bitcoin position and 0.1% buy/sell fees
Explain why source timestamps and simulated quotes are not guaranteed executable
Compare virtual marked holdings with remaining virtual cash
Calculate drawdown and distinguish it from returns without predicting real outcomes
description: Three progressive lessons on virtual Bitcoin trading: snapshots, hypothetical market buy/sell mechanics, fees and honest performance analysis. No live exchange orders or personal recommendations.
progression: Understand virtual cash and price timestamps, calculate fee-inclusive buy/sell transactions, then distinguish total return from drawdown with a written practice debrief.
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with web browsers and digital currencies.

badge.name: Portfolio Architect Badge
badge.description: Demonstrated proficiency in calculating spot position sizes, managing concentration risk, and rebalancing virtual asset portfolios.

title: Diversification and Position Sizing for Spot Paper Trading
notFor: Traders looking for options, futures, leverage, short selling, or real-money financial advice.

lessons.title: Foundations of Asset Allocation and Position Sizing
lessons.summary: Learn how to establish target portfolio weights and calculate precise spot trade sizes using virtual cash.

lessons.title: Managing Concentration Risk and Portfolio Drift
lessons.summary: Understand how concentration risk builds up and how price changes cause your portfolio to drift from its targets.

lessons.title: Executing Rebalancing with Virtual Cash
lessons.summary: Master the mechanics of buying and selling spot assets to realign your portfolio with target allocations.

tagline: Master portfolio construction, position sizing, and rebalancing techniques using $100,000 in virtual cash.
outcomes: Calculate exact position sizes in dollars and units based on target percentage weights.
Identify and mitigate concentration risk within a spot paper trading portfolio.
Execute systematic rebalancing using TradeHQ's virtual cash and market orders.
Formulate a target asset allocation plan suited for a $100,000 virtual balance.
description: Learn how to build balanced spot portfolios, manage concentration risk, calculate percentage weights, and systematically rebalance assets using TradeHQ's paper trading simulator.
progression: This course prepares you to apply risk management principles to advanced trading and simulation scenarios.
prerequisites: Basic understanding of spot market buying and selling.
